title: Mistral Large 4: "Le Chonk"
summary: Mistral AI announces Mistral Large 4 (codenamed 'Le Chonk'), the latest iteration of their flagship large language model series, continuing their mission to deliver powerful open-weight AI models.
problem_solved: Provides a more capable and powerful large language model for developers and enterprises seeking high-performance AI solutions.
why_valuable: Mistral AI continues to democratize access to state-of-the-art AI with competitive open-weight models that rival proprietary alternatives.
